description: SEO settings for a Total CMS collection. Used as a card sub-schema on the collection meta.

id.label: ID
id.help: Reserved — required by the schema system but unused for cards.

type.label: Structured Data Type
type.help: Default JSON-LD type for objects in this collection

options.label: Schema default (Article for blog and feed schemas, Website otherwise)

title.label: Title Property
title.help: Which property supplies the title when the object has no SEO title. Leave empty to use the object's title.

description.label: Description Property
description.help: Which property supplies the meta description when the object has no SEO description

image.label: Image Property
image.help: Which image property supplies the social image
